title: Abyss jewel
wikitext:
'''Abyss jewels''' are a [[item class|class of items]] that function similar to regular [[jewel]]s. They can be obtained from [[Abyssal Trove]]s and as an Abyss reward item from various other [[league]] mechanics.

==Mechanics==
Abyss Jewels are similar to regular jewels, but with a few differences. In addition to being able to be [[Passive_skill#Jewel_sockets|socketed]] on the [[passive skill tree]], Abyss Jewels can also be socketed into [[Abyssal Socket]]s on equipment and {{il|Stygian Vise}}s. Abyss Jewels also have an entirely different set of modifiers in comparison to regular jewels; these modifiers have multiple tiers, with stronger modifiers requiring a higher [[item level]].

Typically, like regular jewels, [[Rarity#Rare|rare]] Abyss Jewels can hold a maximum of 2 prefixes and 2 suffixes, for a total of 4 [[Modifiers|affixes]]. However, it is possible to obtain rare corrupted Abyss Jewels with a total of 5 or 6 modifiers by allocating the [[Corrupted Gaze]] [[Atlas notable]]. [[Allflame crafting]] with {{il|Merrick's Ducat}} adds an extra explicit mod beyond the normal limit and [[Corrupted|corrupts]] it.

The basetype also affects the mod pool:

* {{il|Murderous Eye Jewel}} - Melee attack  modifiers
* {{il|Ghastly Eye Jewel}} - Summoner modifiers
* {{il|Searching Eye Jewel}} - Ranged attack modifiers
* {{il|Hypnotic Eye Jewel}} - Caster modifiers

There is a fifth Abyss jewel base type, {{il|Assembled Eye Jewel}}, which can only be found as a {{c|unique|unique}} item (and subsequently converted it to non-unique rarity).

==Item acquisition==
Abyss jewels primarily drop from [[Abyss]] encounters. Other source include:

* [[Unspeakable Shrine]] node in the [[Abyssal Depths (Delve)|Abyssal Depths]] biome of the [[Azurite Mine]] (Delve)
* {{il|Abyssal Incubator}} (legacy)

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row |3.29.0|
* Abyss has received function changes to the mechanic to improve the gameplay significantly.
* Abyss is now the exclusive source of '''Abyssal Jewels''' and Stygian Vises, though '''Abyssal Jewels''' can still be obtained rarely within Abyss Biomes in Delve.
* Abyssal Jewels can no longer roll increased Damage with Hits and Ailments against Abyssal Monsters, Minions deal increased Damage with Hits and Ailments against Abyssal Monsters, additional Physical Damage Reduction against Abyssal Monsters, or additional Physical Damage Reduction if you weren't Damaged by a Hit Recently.
* Changes have been made to the highest tier Modifiers for Abyssal Jewels, their lower tier counterparts have been adjusted accordingly (read {{section link|version 3.29.0|Abyss Revamp}} for full list)
}}
{{Version history table row |3.20.2|
* Updated the description of the [[Corrupted Gaze]] Atlas Notable Passive to clarify that it only applies to [[Abyss Jewel]]s dropped by [[Abyssal Trove]]s in your Maps.
}}
{{Version history table row |3.14.0|
*A large number of modifiers where added or changed to abyss jewels. New suffix modifiers with ranges include:
* (10–15)% reduced Effect of Curses on you while on Consecrated Ground	
* (8–10)% chance to Avoid Elemental Ailments while you have Elusive	
* Enemies Hindered by you have (15–20)% reduced Life Regeneration rate	
* Enemies Blinded by you have (15–20)% reduced Critical Strike Chance	
* Enemies Withered by you have -2% to all Resistances	
* Enemies Maimed by you take (4–5)% increased Damage Over Time	
* Enemies Intimidated by you have (10–15)% increased duration of stuns against them
*New prefix modifiers with ranges include:
*2% of Damage taken Recouped as Mana	
*3% of Damage taken Recouped as Mana
*(3–4)% increased Impale Effect	
*5% increased Impale Effect
*2% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate	
*3% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate
*2% increased Effect of your Curses	
*3% increased Effect of your Curses
}}
{{Version history table row |3.7.0|
*The values on Life, Mana and Energy Shield modifiers on '''Abyssal Jewels''' have been reduced, and the top tiers made rarer relative to lower tiers. The top roll for these modifiers is now 40 (from 50). Divining existing jewels will update them to these new values, so don't do that unless you're hoping to create one of those 'viral videos' that are all the rage these days.
*Added damage of all types on '''Abyssal Jewels''' has also been lowered, by about 30% at the top end, scaling down to lower tiers. Top tiers of these have also become rarer. This is true for all top-tier added damage modifiers on '''Abyssal Jewels''', including caster and summoner ones.
}}
{{Version history table row |3.1.0|
* Abyss jewels have been added to the game
}}
{{Version history table end}}
